info.name: nc_bot_webhooks
info.summary: Webhook bridge for Nextcloud Talk (Discord, Apprise, and Slack formats) with image support
info.description: Accepts Discord webhook-style, Apprise, and Slack incoming-webhook JSON payloads and posts them into Nextcloud Talk rooms, preserving image attachments. Each room gets its own webhook URL with an auth token for security.
info.author: Kyle
